exact_prompt:
Edit this ENTIRE exact game diffuse source UV canvas into a very modest HD painted version. This reference is made ONLY by converting original stored RGB to opaqueRGB and nearest-enlarging the WHOLE original canvas. Return exactly the same entire canvas aspect, normalized UV positions, source part dimensions/outlines, faint marks, gaps, source scale, pattern count/phase and unequal local intensities. No crop, padding, frame, whitespace, zoom, fitting, rotation, rearrangement or newly visible components. Original source alpha will be restored separately. Source black is original shadowpaint, not an invitation to add physical holes or hardware.

Native source64x64 is a very dark olive-gray painted equipment atlas. Preserve the THREE existing pale curved painted-band portions at upper-left, middle-left, and clipped lower-middle, their original incomplete arcs, thickness and uneven weak shading. Original source measured bright anchors are native7,30 (RGB181/190/165),5,52 (RGB99/101/99),26,60 (RGB90/85/82); retain their exact weak relative strengths and footprint, no bright new rims or circles. Preserve the original darkgray rounded broad patches in the center/right and original black source shadows/gaps. The far-right narrow olive/gray source painted field retains all original faint strips and shadows; native mean-profile light maxima x46,50,52,56,58,62 over y16..38 are IRREGULAR source tonal positions, not new physical ribs or straps. Do not regularize into a new repeated grid. No newly inserted lenses/bolts/holes, no brighter curved edge or glints.

Only gently resolve the existing extremely subdued fine painted material. Keep original matte gray/warm/olive color and all original weak local relationships. Fine light paint remains faint paint, never a white raised seam/rim, glowing rod, thicker bevel, hardware, new crisp regular knurl or relief. Nearblack and almost-flat fields stay nearblack/almost-flat. Preserve source irregular boundaries and variable shading without inventing new lines/patterns. No added fastener, buckle, bolt, rivet, hole, pocket, strap, button, stitch, crease, diamond, weave, woodgrain, rust, photographic grain, scratch, shine, lensreflection, lettering, symbol, mark or decorative curl. Output the ENTIRE opaque source texture aspect with exact UV layout.
